sentences.text: Present: Mr. Chirag Suri, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. Ankur Mittal, Advocate for respondent No.3.

MAHABIR SINGH SINDHU, J.
Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution for directing the respondents to make payment of enhanced compensation along with interest and other benefits in view of order dated 27.08.2015,
passed by learned Land Acquisition Collector in application under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 2.
Learned counsel, on instructions from petitioners, submits that the desired relief has already been granted; thus present petition be disposed off as having been rendered infructuous.
